root_overlay: Debian overlayroot, read-only lower, RAM upper reset at reboot; min(MemTotal/8, 128 MiB), rounded down to 4 KiB; inode limit equals budget KiB / 4
output_layout: ab-v2: ROOT_A, ROOT_B, BOOT_CONTROL, STATE (last partition, expands to detected card capacity)
ota_framework: RAUC signed plain bundle with custom U-Boot selector/backend
state_expansion: Preinstalled growpart and resize2fs run during state preparation; exact minimum image size checked by writer; no fixed card capacity
early_hang_recovery: Accepted operational boundary: on-site power cycle if the kernel/initramfs hangs before systemd can enforce a trial deadline
initial_password_setup: Only a per-device root recovery password is requested; pi password remains locked and is never requested
sudo_authentication: Key-authorized pi administrator has NOPASSWD ALL; no pi or root password is required for sudo; obsolete narrow bootstrap grants are removed
ssh_bootstrap: Operator supplies --ssh-key during factory flashing; first interactive pi SSH login automatically enters setup; local/serial console offers the same wizard before normal login
build_stage_logs: work/build.XXXXXXXX/logs/<stage>.log and stages.tsv; always collected as a separate Actions artifact
tailscale_control_selection: /etc/network-exit/tailscale-control.json on STATE; client preferences/identity persist separately on STATE; no unattended control-plane switching
first_boot_ui: OS root recovery-password prompt followed by an English Textual service dashboard; automatic on interactive pi login or local/serial console; Finish setup checks authorization/services before STATE completion
controller_config_command: enodectl config opens the same Textual service dashboard after account preparation; public service command restored; legacy config ssh/service/network and init/add-key routes removed
ssh_authentication: publickey only; PasswordAuthentication no, KbdInteractiveAuthentication no, PermitEmptyPasswords no, AuthenticationMethods publickey; UsePAM yes for account/session processing
ssh_user_ca: SSH page under enodectl service manages login and CA entries; trust persists on STATE at /etc/network-exit/ssh-user-ca.pub; at least one validated login/CA authorization required
ssh_access_ui: Textual table: purpose, type, SHA256 fingerprint and escaped comment; Add login/CA, Details, Remove and explicit Save; staging, cancellation and last-authorization protection
ssh_key_management_entrypoint: enodectl service -> SSH / public keys / CA; no separate importer/add-key command; factory pi-key personalization retained
service_management_ui: enodectl service: Textual dashboard, repeatable per-service forms, staged optional startup changes, confirmed Apply and discard; mandatory SSH/Tailscale/system components cannot be disabled; fixed policy pages are read-only; OTA also exposes explicit signed/recovery installation
ddns: Optional preinstalled ddclient; default disabled; Cloudflare/DuckDNS/DynDNS2; one A or AAAA profile; credentials/cache/status on STATE; bounded one-shot systemd timer; no real provider updates tested
host_firewall: Optional/default OFF enode_host nftables table; explicit SSH source CIDRs/uplink listener ports; owned-table atomic updates; independent WG protection retained when OFF
network_trial: 90-second systemd rollback timer plus STATE previous-config record; explicit keep confirmation; unconfirmed boot restores previous network settings
network_management: Ethernet DHCP plus IPv4LL/mDNS provisioning; persistent WPA2/WPA3 Wi-Fi through Netplan/networkd; joint 90-second network/Wi-Fi trials and early-boot rollback; managed firewall/SSH on both physical links; route-driven exit uplink refresh
build_stage_plan: image_builder/stages.json: plain non-empty JSON array of 25 stage IDs; order only, with context/dependencies in stage/<id>/stage.json
source_asset_layout: stage/<id> requires stage.json and install.sh only; enodectl_component/, rootfs_layer/ requirements.txt and config/ are optional and omitted when unnecessary; no placeholder files or global source rootfs
enodectl_packaging: shiv 1.0.8; Textual 8.2.8 plus dependencies, generic core and build-selected stage modules; ARM64-compatible runtime wheels; isolated launcher with root cache on /run; no device downloads
software_inventory: output/enodectl-manifest.json plus package-manifest.tsv; manifest includes selected stages, layer ownership, shiv and Python dependency versions; included in factory archive
tui_logic_separation: Per-stage *_view.py/ssh_view.py/service_tui.py presentation; *_config.py/ssh_editor.py/service_manager.py backends; shared Textual form/confirmation/status widgets in enodectl_core/textual_ui.py

build_stage_contexts.host-shell: Shared build_stage function for image resources and cleanup state
build_stage_contexts.host: Separate builder process with image context

build_runtime_helpers: image_builder/build.sh, plan.sh and runtime.sh; root build.sh delegates to the builder; root package-release.py delegates to image_builder.package_release; no scripts directory
